title: Editor completely freezes when closing the debug game window
body:
### Tested versions

I'm experiencing this issue on 4.4.1_mono and 4.5-rc2_mono. Happens on the non mono versions as well

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 11 Sep 2025 17:42:36 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

When I open any project, including a brand new one, then run the game and close it, godot completely hangs. I'm not able to interact with anything, and Godot must be killed to close. In the logs, I see:

`ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS" is true. Returning: FAILED
   at: command_queue_execute_and_present (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:2753)`
The error is the same for both versions, with 4.4 giving line 2655, and 4.5 rc2 giving line 2753. On 4.4, the game window doesn't close, it just goes blank, and the editor freezes. On 4.5, the game window closes, then the editor freezes. 

I'm running on Arch Linux, kernel 6.16.7, Vulkan radeon 1:25.2.2-2. I was following the journal as godot froze, but didn't see any relevant info in the journal

### Steps to reproduce

Create a new project. Add a 3d node with a camera. Save the scene, then run the scene, and close the debug window

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22323805/new-game-project.zip)
